import openpyxl

input_path = sys.argv[1]
output_path = sys.argv[2]

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb.active

# Collect branches (column A) and their checked status (column I, 'ü' = checked).
branches = []
for row in range(2, 8):  # rows 2-7 hold BR1..BR6
    name = ws.cell(row=row, column=1).value
    if name is None:
        continue
    checked = ws.cell(row=row, column=9).value  # column I
    is_checked = (checked is not None and str(checked).strip() != '')
    if not is_checked:
        branches.append(name)

# Write unticked branches into A13:A14
for i, name in enumerate(branches):
    ws.cell(row=13 + i, column=1, value=name)

wb.save(output_path)
print("Wrote branches:", branches)", "path": "/bench/answers/58499/solution.py"}, "name": "write"}
